reviewed_invariants: prepare_and_save parses and validates a private Tune/tree, checks and owns the cJSON-allocated encoded text, and only then enters persist_prepared. The document revision is expected+1 while the candidate carries expected for CAS.

persist_prepared checks storage state and expected revision while holding the service mutex. Only successful NVS set/commit changes active Tune, revision, owned document, controller state, stamp and latest data. Failing NVS closes the configuration fence using the old revision and blocks subsequent saves.

tuning_commit copies the current canonical document while checking candidate revision under the same mutex, updates a private tree outside it, and repeats CAS inside persist_prepared. A concurrent HTTP/USB winner invalidates the prepared loser before its fence or persistence call.

unique_ptr ownership frees private cJSON strings on invalid, busy, stale and failed-storage paths. On success document.swap transfers the new buffer into active ownership; the previous document is freed after the fence/mutex operation finishes.

The new engine_storage const-char/size API rejects null, empty, oversized and embedded-NUL input before opening NVS. Its byte length excludes the terminator; nonterminated bounded input works. It closes every successfully opened handle and propagates open/set/commit errors.

Own004 files carry a connection origin at baseRevision. Browser imports preserve that value in editor-only origin metadata and keep the already loaded editor revision as the HTTP CAS base. Import never fetches a newer revision or silently rebases a stale editor.

Exact historical001/002/003 import revision matching remains active; mismatches leave the editor unchanged. Python import/export retains origin revision losslessly, while whole-page own004 constants are flattened to page0.
Current Python MSQ scalar/array units match all72 INI declarations, including injection_end_deg, cam_sync_deg and cam_window_deg after the parent units fix.

limits: The fake-NVS/FreeRTOS harness compiles actual engine_service.cpp, but tests caller operations and activation ordering only. It does not establish physical flash capacity, wear, NVS recovery, power-loss atomicity, electrical behavior, USB enumeration or sustained target performance.
NVS commit/write failures can leave new flash bytes present despite an error. The tested guarantee is retained active in-memory state and blocked later saves, not physical rollback.
